description: Whether a constituent is a foreign part depends on where it stands in the chosen derivation, not on what it derives. The two `inner` constituents derive the same empty span. The first lies inside the foreign part `outer`, so it is no foreign part, and its token has no parts and sounds ``. The second is a foreign part itself, so its token sounds `?` (engine §5, §11).
grammar:
%rule text outer inner
%rule outer inner
%foreign
%rule inner ε
%emits $ <X>
%foreign
